submitted.rationale: I measured EQE at five points spread across the Sb fraction range: 0.358 gave 0.0166%, 0.511 gave 0.0243%, 0.5955 gave 0.0641%, 0.679 gave 0.0514% and 0.707 gave 0.0388%. The response peaks between the Pb2Sb2O7 (Sb 0.5) and PbSb2O6 (Sb 0.667) compositions. Index 20 (Sb 0.5955) had the highest measured EQE.
